This document is exported under a prepared CSS setting, and each row below says what it proves. The expected image can be read without opening the test.

The CSS setting paints this row: a yellow fill, a blue border and a tile at its right edge. A row without the fill or the border says the whole stylesheet was dropped; a row without the tile says the stylesheet kept everything but the address it could not load.

The picture below is an attachment of this document. It travels with the project, so no external-resource policy applies to it and it has to be painted whatever happens to the rest.

The picture below is named by an address the policy refuses. The dashed frame below is the picture itself, at the size the document gives it: it holds its place and paints nothing.
